introHtml: Mgroup brings rugged durability and classic outdoor style to custom beer mugs and steins. Their campfire mugs and speckled tumblers are built for heavy use, making them ideal for brewery promotions, company picnics, or trade show giveaways. Choose from sizes like 15 oz or 16 oz and add your logo with screen printing or full-color decoration. These mugs hold up to repeated dishwasher cycles and still look great.
